**The wave effect now carries the accent.** The base dot grid and the sweeping band were still drawn in grey, so
turning **Red accents** on recoloured the compile, magnet, diamond and rain effects but left the wave — the default
one — untouched. The field, the sweep and the boot and ladder rows now take the accent too, so every effect in the
Home screen reads as one picture.

**A red accent no longer floods the posters.** With **Red accents** on, hovering or focusing a cover was supposed to
keep its monochrome and mark it with a red wash, but the old rule let the full-colour cover through underneath. The
cover now stays in black and white and the red wash is the only thing on top of it — which is what the setting
promised in the first place.

**Everything else stayed as it was.** Nothing outside the Home screen and the accent switch changed in this release,
and the plugin still only changes how Steam looks, never how it works.

**Install / update:** grab `VoidDeck-v1.8.1.zip` from the [v1.8.1 release](https://github.com/endoflineservice/VoidDeck/releases/tag/v1.8.1), or press **Update now** in the Void Deck panel.
